description:
Experience premium city living in this stunning studio apartment at The Stage, a landmark development in the heart of Shoreditch. Thoughtfully designed for modern lifestyles, the apartment offers a bright open-plan layout with a fully integrated contemporary kitchen, a well-defined sleeping area, a sleek modern bathroom, and a private balcony — providing the perfect blend of comfort and style in one of London"s most vibrant neighbourhoods.
Finished to a high specification throughout, the space is both elegant and practical, ideal for professionals seeking a refined base moments from the City.
Residents benefit from exceptional five-star facilities, including a 24-hour concierge, a state-of-the-art gym, two private cinemas, bowling lanes with a games lounge, executive business suites, and an exclusive 32nd-floor sky lounge with a landscaped terrace offering impressive skyline views.
Perfectly positioned just minutes from Liverpool Street and Old Street stations, the development sits at the meeting point of Shoreditch"s creative scene and the City"s financial district. With renowned restaurants, stylish bars, boutique shops, and Spitalfields Market all within walking distance, this apartment offers an unrivalled lifestyle opportunity.
Early viewing is highly recommended.

A super modern two bedroom apartment on the 7th floor of this purpose built block, offering views over Trevor Square and Knightsbridge from the main rooms. The flat has been recently refurbished and offers contemporary décor throughout. Princes Court is situated on the Brompton Road directly opposite Harrods so is ideally located for all the amenities of Knightsbridge, Sloane Square and Hyde Park. Welcome to your HomeQuarters
This pet-friendly apartment in Hoxton is professionally managed as part of the HomeQuarters portfolio.
Upon arrival you'll receive a full demonstration and introduction to the area by our dedicated HomeQuarters representative.
Location
Experience the charm of Hoxton, a historic London neighbourhood blending rich cultural heritage with modern flair. This sought-after area offers a range of markets, diverse cuisine, bustling nightlife and amazing coffee shops all on your doorstep. Enjoy stylish living in a dynamic neighbourhood, perfect for urban explorers and culture enthusiasts alike.
The apartment
This apartment is newly refurbished and boasts a modern designed open-plan living / kitchen area with fully fitted appliances such as an integrated oven, fridge freezer, hob, and dishwasher. The apartment has new wood flooring throughout, and two generously sized double bedrooms with plenty of wardrobe space, additional storage and a contemporary fitted bathroom suite. All furniture is brand new. Please note, the furniture may vary slightly from the photographs.
Transport links
The flat is extremely convenient for the City, which is within walking distance, as well as all the amenities of Brick Lane and Shoreditch. Transport links are excellent, being a few minutes walk to Old Street rail and Underground station (Northern line), and Shoreditch High Street (Overground).

Recently refurbished serviced three bedroom maisonette is an impressive 1700ft2 and comfortably sleeps six making it the perfect choice for families or friends looking to make the most of The Capital's prime location
Light and spacious with floor to ceiling windows in both the sitting room and en-suite master bedroom and an outside terrace perfect for enjoying breakfast with a view of the Knightsbridge rooftops. The large open-plan kitchen dining area has plenty of space to entertain. The flat is moments away from Harrods and all the amenities of Knightsbridge and Sloane Street. Ideal for access to the theatres of the West End, Mayfair, St James' and Sloane Square. Hyde Park is 5 minutes walk away. Available for long and short lets (rents vary for longer term tenancies so please enquire).
For further information please visit plazaestates.co.uk

SHORT LET* A spacious apartment in the heart of Shoreditch. The property comprises; a double bedroom with en-suite shower room, a further double bedroom, bathroom and a large open plan kitchen/reception room with private balcony.
Residents benefit from an enviable location, moments from Shoreditch High Street, Spitalfields Market, and Brick Lane, offering an eclectic mix of boutiques, restaurants, and cultural attractions right on your doorstep. Excellent transport links include Shoreditch High Street Overground and Liverpool Street Station, ensuring easy access across London.
Ideal for professionals or investors seeking a prime East London address, this property delivers style, space, and convenience in equal measure.
